ex.en: Overhead may be high and circulation lower, but rushing to eliminate its print edition would be a mistake, says BuzzFeed CEO Jonah Peretti.
ex.zh: 也许经费开支较高而发行量较低，但急于取消印刷版本将会是个错误，BuzzFeed执行总裁乔纳·佩雷蒂说道。

ex.en: The newspaper doubled its circulation by offering free digital access.
ex.zh: 这家报纸通过提供免费数字阅读使发行量翻了一番。

ex.en: Doctors advised short walks to improve the circulation in his legs.
ex.zh: 医生建议进行短距离散步，以改善他的腿部血液循环。

senses: n. (pl.) ①情况，形势，环境：under the present ~s 在目前情况下
circumstance.usage: circumstance 指某事发生时的情况、环境，常用复数；environment 指周围环境总称；surroundings 指周围的事物。；circumstance 常用复数，指某事发生时的情况、环境；environment 指自然环境或对人的发展有影响的环境总称；surroundings 指周围的事物、环境(复数

ex.en: You may feel guilt over your past, but you are poisoning the present with the things and circumstances you cannot change.
ex.zh: 你可能会对自己的过去感到内疚，但这是在用你无法改变的事情和境况来荼毒你的现在。

ex.en: Under no circumstances should personal information be shared with unregistered third-party applications.
ex.zh: 在任何情况下都不得与未注册的第三方应用共享个人信息。

ex.en: Financial circumstances forced her to abandon her studies, though she later returned to university part-time.
ex.zh: 经济状况迫使她中断学业，不过她后来以业余方式重返大学。

senses: vt. ①引用，引证，举(例)：The lawyer ~d a previous case. 律师引用了一个先前的案例。
②(法律)传唤，传讯：He was ~d in a divorce case. 他因离婚案被传讯。
③(军事)表彰，嘉奖：He was ~d for bravery in battle. 他因作战勇敢受到嘉奖。
cite.usage: cite 指引用权威资料、先例等；quote 指原文原封不动引用。；cite 指为证明或增强说服力而引用书籍、权威言论或实例；quote 指一字不差地引用原文。；辨析：cite 指间引，引用时不需用相同的词；quote 指直引，直接引用原文，不做丝毫修改；派生 citation n. 引用，引述，引证；v.引用，援引；

ex.en: This would be reasonable if it were not for the fact that scientists can easily arrange to cite themselves in their future publications, or get associates to do so for them in return for similar favours.
ex.zh: 如果科学家没有轻易在其未来的出版物中引用自己的论文，或者没有为了以换取类似的好处而让同行为他们这样做，那么，该索引则是合理的。

ex.en: She cited examples of companies the city has helped relocate or expand.
ex.zh: 她列举了该市帮助搬迁或扩张的公司的例子。

ex.en: Supporters cite falling crime rates as evidence that the policy works.
ex.zh: 支持者援引犯罪率下降作为政策有效的证据。

ex.en: The court cited several previous rulings in reaching its decision.
ex.zh: 法院在作出裁决时援引了多个先前判例。

senses: n. ①公民：a Chinese ~ 中国公民
②市民，城镇居民：the ~s of Beijing 北京市民

ex.en: Senior citizens are entitled to free bus travel in many cities.
ex.zh: 在许多城市，老年人可以免费乘坐公交车。

ex.en: Every citizen has a duty to vote in the national election.
ex.zh: 每个公民都有义务在全国选举中投票。

ex.en: Local citizens organised a campaign against the closure of the town library.
ex.zh: 当地市民组织了一场反对关闭镇图书馆的运动。

senses: n. [U] 公民权利（或资格）；公民身份（或义务）
n. 公民权利(或资格),公民身份(或义务)
n. 公民身份；公民权利

ex.en: Immigrants can apply for citizenship after five years of residence.
ex.zh: 移民居住满五年后可申请公民身份。

ex.en: Schools are expected to teach citizenship as well as academic subjects.
ex.zh: 人们期望学校既开设公民教育课，也教学术科目。

ex.en: Obeying the country's laws is a basic duty of citizenship.
ex.zh: 遵守国家法律是公民身份的一项基本义务。

senses: n. 都市；城市；特许市；特权市
n. 城市，都市：the ~ of Shanghai 上海市
a. 平民的；国内的；民事的
civil.usage: 串词记忆：有礼貌的(civil)公民不做邪恶的(evil)事；索引p404

ex.en: We have been actively exercising our civil rights.
ex.zh: 我们一直在积极行使自己的公民权利。

ex.en: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
ex.zh: （该研究）不仅仅关注国内生产总值，还衡量了包括健康、教育和公民社会参与等在内的40多套标准，从而对一个国家的表现进行更加全面的评价。

ex.en: The new law protects civil liberties, including the right to assemble peacefully in public places.
ex.zh: 新法律保护公民自由，包括在公共场所和平集会的权利。

senses: n. 平民，百姓：Many ~s were killed in the war. 战争中许多平民丧生。
adj. 平民的，民用的：~ clothes 便装
n. 平民,百姓(不在军队或警察部队中服役的人)

ex.en: Both men emphasized the dirt and exhaustion of war, the fragments of civilization that the soldiers shared with each other and the civilians: coffee, tobacco, whiskey, shelter, sleep.
ex.zh: 这二人都浓墨重彩地描写了战争的艰辛与疲惫，以及那些在士兵之间、士兵和平民百姓之间分享咖啡、香烟、威士忌、避难所和睡梦的文明碎片。

ex.en: The report estimates that thousands of civilians were displaced by the fighting.
ex.zh: 报告估计数千平民因战乱流离失所。

ex.en: After leaving the army, he found it hard to adjust to civilian life.
ex.zh: 退伍后，他发现自己很难适应平民生活。

ex.en: Yet science has a cultural history, too, with roots going back to the dawn of civilisation.
ex.zh: 然而，科学也有一段文化史，其根源可以追溯到文明的开端。

ex.en: Such behaviour is totally unacceptable in a civilised society.
ex.zh: 这种行为在文明社会是完全不能被接受的。

senses: n. ①文明(可数)：ancient ~s 古代文明
②文化，文明社会(总称，不可数)：The history of ~ is the history of human progress. 文明史就是人类进步史。

ex.en: Ancient civilizations developed sophisticated systems of writing and trade.
ex.zh: 古代文明发展出了成熟的文字和贸易体系。

ex.en: Some historians argue that climate change contributed to the collapse of entire civilizations.
ex.zh: 一些历史学家认为气候变化是整个文明衰落的原因之一。

ex.en: Modern civilization depends heavily on networks of energy and communication.
ex.zh: 现代文明在很大程度上依赖能源和通信网络。

senses: adj. 文明的；开化的；有礼貌的

claim.usage: critics claim that... 评论家声称……；辨析：claim 根据法律、产权等强调有权得到；demand 因权限、权利或需要而坚持要求；request 正式用语，比 ask 正式、比 demand 客气；require 根据权利要求所需的东西，语气比 demand 弱；v.声称，断言；索取；认领； 获得

ex.en: They even claimed that plants have 'brain-like command centers' at their root tips.
ex.zh: 他们甚至声称，植物的根尖有'类似大脑的指挥中心'。

ex.en: You can make a claim on your insurance policy.
ex.zh: 你可按保险单索赔。

ex.en: One company in the UK, Phrasel, claims their software can outperform humans by up to 10 percent when it comes to email open rates.
ex.zh: 英国一家名为Phrasel的公司声称，在电子邮件点击率方面，他们的软件胜于人工，邮件点击率可高出10%。

senses: n. 要求者,索要者;(因失业等)领取救济金者
n. （因失业等）领取救济金者；索赔人
claimant.usage: 词根记忆：claim(shout，叫喊)+ant(表人)→叫喊索赔的人→索赔人；索引p404

ex.en: Each claimant must provide proof of identity before receiving benefits.
ex.zh: 每位申领人在领取救济金前必须提供身份证明。

ex.en: Delays in processing claims have left many claimants without income for months.
ex.zh: 理赔处理的拖延使许多申领人数月没有收入。

ex.en: The insurance company rejected the claimant's application for lack of evidence.
ex.zh: 保险公司以证据不足为由驳回了索赔人的申请。

senses: v. 紧紧抓住,紧夹住,被抓住,被夹紧
vi./vt. ①拍手，鼓掌：The audience ~ed warmly after the concert. 音乐会后观众热烈鼓掌。
vi. ②(upon)(旧用法)突然抓住，握住(较少用)
clap.usage: 助记:他clap(拍)了一下lap(大腿)；发音类似“客来铺”→客人来到店铺时员工拍手表示欢迎

ex.en: The audience clapped warmly at the end of the student concert.
ex.zh: 学生音乐会结束时，观众热烈鼓掌。

ex.en: Residents clapped from their balconies to thank the medical workers.
ex.zh: 居民们在阳台上鼓掌，感谢医护工作者。

ex.en: With a clap of thunder, the storm finally broke over the valley.
ex.zh: 随着一声炸雷，暴风雨终于席卷了山谷。

senses: vt. 使更清晰易懂；澄清；纯净，净化
clarify.usage: clar（clear 清楚）+-ify（使）→使清楚→澄清。族：clarity n. 清晰；明晰。近义：explain vt. 解释；助记:clar(clear清楚的)+ify(动词后缀,使……)→使……清楚→澄清;反义confuse vt.使混淆;派生clarification n.澄清；v.澄清，阐明；clear的

ex.en: The ministry issued a statement to clarify its position on the disputed examination reform.
ex.zh: 该部委发表声明，澄清其在备受争议的考试改革上的立场。

ex.en: Could you clarify what documents are required for applicants who previously studied abroad?
ex.zh: 您能否澄清一下，此前在海外学习的申请人需要提交哪些材料？

ex.en: The report clarifies several points that were widely misunderstood by the press last week.
ex.zh: 该报告澄清了上周被媒体广泛误解的几个要点。

senses: n. 清楚，明确；清晰的思维能力

phrases.m: 得到无与伦比的清晰图像

clarity.usage: clarify 的派生词；助记:clar(看作clear清晰的)+ity(名词后缀)→清晰；词根记忆：clar(clear，清晰的)+ity→清晰；索引p404

ex.en: The professor explains abstract theories with remarkable clarity, which makes his lectures very popular.
ex.zh: 这位教授讲解抽象理论异常清晰，因此他的课很受欢迎。

ex.en: The clarity of the lake water allows visitors to see fish swimming several meters below the surface.
ex.zh: 湖水清澈，游客可以看到在水面以下数米处游动的鱼。

ex.en: She answered the journalists' questions with clarity and confidence, avoiding any vague statements.
ex.zh: 她清晰而自信地回答了记者的提问，没有作任何含糊的表述。

senses: vi. ①冲突，交锋：The two groups ~ed outside the court. 两伙人在法庭外发生了冲突。
②(颜色、风格等)不协调，不和谐：The red wallpaper ~es with the green carpet. 红墙纸与绿地毯不协调。
n. ③冲突：an armed ~ 武装冲突

ex.en: The astonishing distrust of the news media isn't rooted in inaccuracy or poor reportorial skills but in the daily clash of world views between reporters and their readers.
ex.zh: 这种对新闻媒介惊人的不信任，其根源并不是报道失实或低劣的报道技巧，而是记者与读者的世界观每天都发生碰撞。

ex.en: The concert clashes with the final exam schedule, so many students cannot attend.
ex.zh: 音乐会与期末考试时间冲突，许多学生无法参加。

ex.en: Protesters clashed with police outside the conference centre on Saturday.
ex.zh: 周六，抗议者在会议中心外与警察发生冲突。

senses: n. 拥抱,握手;扣子,钩子

ex.en: Students from working-class families remain under-represented at elite universities.
ex.zh: 工人阶级家庭的学生在精英大学中的比例仍然偏低。

ex.en: The economics class meets three times a week in the main building.
ex.zh: 经济学课每周上三次，地点在主楼。

ex.en: Analysts warn that the middle class is shrinking in many developed countries.
ex.zh: 分析人士警告说，许多发达国家的中产阶级正在萎缩。

classic.usage: classic 指第一流的、堪称典范的，或指典型的事例；classical 指古典的，与古希腊罗马文化相关的，或指传统的。；派生classical adj.古典的，经典的

ex.en: This was a classic case of what not to do.
ex.zh: 这是一个不该做什么的典型例子。

ex.en: The museum displays classic cars from the 1950s and 1960s.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了二十世纪五六十年代的经典汽车。

ex.en: Dickens's novels are regarded as classics of English literature.
ex.zh: 狄更斯的小说被视为英国文学的经典名著。

senses: adj. ①古典的，经典的：~ music 古典音乐 / ~ studies 古典文学研究
②(语言)文言的，与古希腊罗马文学相关的
classical.usage: adj.经典的；古典的；典型的， 有代表性的

ex.en: They gained some knowledge of classical art and architecture.
ex.zh: 他们获得了一些古典艺术和建筑方面的知识。

ex.en: Classical economics assumes that markets will correct themselves over time.
ex.zh: 古典经济学假定市场会随时间推移自行纠正。

ex.en: The palace blends classical design with distinctly modern materials.
ex.zh: 这座宫殿将古典设计与鲜明的现代材料融为一体。

ex.en: The study of classical literature remains central to the school curriculum.
ex.zh: 古典文学研究仍然是学校课程的核心内容。

classification.usage: n.分类，分级；类别，级别；索引p404

ex.en: The classification of new species often depends on genetic evidence rather than appearance.
ex.zh: 新物种的分类往往取决于基因证据而非外观。

ex.en: Libraries rely on a shared classification system to organise their holdings.
ex.zh: 图书馆依靠统一的分类系统来整理馆藏。

ex.en: Any classification of mental disorders is bound to involve a degree of judgement.
ex.zh: 任何精神障碍的分类都必然涉及一定程度的主观判断。

senses: vt. ①把……分类，把……分级：Eggs are ~ied according to size. 鸡蛋按大小分类。
②把……归类(为)：Whales are ~ied as mammals. 鲸被归为哺乳动物。
classify.usage: 助记:class(级别)+ify(动词后缀,使……)→分等级;派生classifiable adj.可分类的;classified adj.分类的；v.把……分类，分级；界定， 划分；索引p404

ex.en: Scientists classify volcanoes according to the frequency of their eruptions.
ex.zh: 科学家根据喷发频率对火山进行分类。

ex.en: The new law classifies such platforms as publishers, making them responsible for content.
ex.zh: 新法律将此类平台归类为出版商，使其对内容负责。

ex.en: It is difficult to classify the new genre within existing musical categories.
ex.zh: 很难将这一新的音乐流派归入现有的类别。

senses: n. (正式文件或法律文件的)条款
adj. ①易懂的，明白的；②清澈的，明亮的；③通畅的，无阻的
clear.usage: 反义 unclear 不清楚的；另 clear out 清理掉；clear up 整理；消除；澄清；adj.易懂的，明白的；明显的； 清晰的 v.清除，清理；辨析：普通用词，侧重指清楚的、明显的；②清除2017年新题型：manufacturers have to clear another major hurdle；索

ex.en: If it clears the House, this measure would still have to get through the Senate.
ex.zh: 此举措如果在众议院得以通过，也仍需获得参议院的批准。

ex.en: The evidence makes it clear that early intervention saves money in the long run.
ex.zh: 证据清楚地表明，早期干预从长远来看能节省开支。

ex.en: Farmers were told to clear the land before the rainy season arrived.
ex.zh: 农民被告知要在雨季来临前清理土地。

ex.en: Her explanation was clear enough for beginners to follow.
ex.zh: 她的讲解足够清晰，初学者也能听懂。

senses: adj. 明显的,分明的,明确的
a. 聪明的；油腔滑调的；灵巧的；精明的
adj. 聪明的,伶俐的,机敏的
n. 委托人；当事人；客户

ex.en: I don't know if other clients are going to abandon me.
ex.zh: 我不知道其他的客户会不会抛弃我。

ex.en: Law firms are under pressure to reduce the fees they charge their clients.
ex.zh: 律师事务所面临压力，需要降低向客户收取的费用。

ex.en: The consultant's advice was tailored to the specific needs of each client.
ex.zh: 顾问的建议是针对每位客户的具体需求量身定制的。

ex.en: Banks that ignore the concerns of smaller clients risk losing them to competitors.
ex.zh: 忽视小客户关切的银行可能把这些客户拱手让给竞争对手。

cliff.usage: 发音类似“可立扶”→站在“悬崖”边快掉下去时，可以立刻扶住旁边的一棵树→悬崖，峭壁。

ex.en: The cliff is gradually crumbling away.
ex.zh: 峭壁正在逐渐坍塌。

ex.en: Houses built close to the cliff edge are at risk of collapse.
ex.zh: 建在悬崖边缘附近的房屋面临倒塌的危险。

ex.en: Seabirds nest on the steep cliffs along the northern coast.
ex.zh: 海鸟在北部沿海陡峭的悬崖上筑巢。

climate.usage: 辨析:climate指某地区较长时期的气候;weather指短期内(一天至一周)的天气变化；我估计estimate明天的天气climate应该不错；索引p404

ex.en: They hope this will provide the right climate for social change.
ex.zh: 他们希望这将为社会变革提供合适的环境。

ex.en: Farmers must adapt their planting schedules to a changing climate.
ex.zh: 农民必须使种植计划适应不断变化的气候。

ex.en: The scandal created a climate of distrust within the organisation.
ex.zh: 这起丑闻在组织内部造成了不信任的氛围。

ex.en: In the present economic climate, few firms are willing to invest in untested technology.
ex.zh: 在当前的经济环境下，几乎没有企业愿意投资未经检验的技术。

phrases.m: 进入(车子等)/从(车子等)出来

senses: vi. 附着；缠着；紧紧抓住（或抱住）
cling.usage: cling to 缠着，紧靠着；过去式为 clung，不与 with 搭配；v.抓住，抱紧；粘住；依恋； 坚守；v.抓住；粘住；依恋，坚守 inhabitant/ɪn'hæbɪtənt/词频；发音类似“可怜”→那个可怜的孩子一直“紧紧抓住”母亲的衣角，一刻都不离开。；cling to 过去式/过去分词 clung。；索

ex.en: I clung closely to my mother's arm.
ex.zh: 我紧紧抓着妈妈的胳膊。

ex.en: Survivors clung to the hope of rescue.
ex.zh: 幸存者们紧抱着获救的希望。

ex.en: Everyone around us seems to agree by the way they cling to their phones, even without a signal on a subway.
ex.zh: 我们周围的每个人似乎都赞成在路上一直玩手机，即使是在没有信号的地铁里。

senses: n. 门诊部，诊所；门诊时间；私人诊所
clinic.usage: 形近对照法：你跟朋友去野餐（picnic），吃坏了肚子，必须得去诊所（clinic）看一下。；野餐（picnic）时吃坏了肚子，要去诊所（clinic）看一下

ex.en: He failed to keep his appointment at the clinic.
ex.zh: 他未能按预约的时间去诊所。

ex.en: The new clinic offers free check-ups to residents over sixty.
ex.zh: 新诊所为六十岁以上的居民提供免费体检。

ex.en: She runs a private clinic specialising in sleep disorders.
ex.zh: 她开办了一家专治睡眠障碍的私人诊所。

ex.en: He pulled his cloak tighter against the freezing wind.
ex.zh: 他裹紧斗篷，抵御刺骨的寒风。

ex.zh: 考古学家希望遗址能提供有关古城陷落原因的线索。

ex.zh: 你可以根据上下文线索猜出新词的意思。

ex.en: Competition law appears to be the only way to address these imbalances of power. But it is clumsy.
ex.zh: 竞争法似乎是解决这些权力失衡问题的唯一方法。但这种方式笨拙不堪。

ex.zh: 政府对谈判的拙劣处理激怒了双方。

ex.zh: 早期的机器人很笨拙，只能执行最简单的任务。

ex.en: He made a clumsy attempt to hide his disappointment at the result.
ex.zh: 他笨拙地试图掩饰自己对结果的失望。

senses: n. (果实、花等的)串,束,簇;(人或物)的群,组

coalition.usage: 记：coalit（联合）+-ion（名词后缀）→个人、集体或阶级的联合体→联盟；coal(煤)+ition(名词后缀)→有煤才能联合→联合；n.联合政府；联合体，联盟； 联合；词根记忆：co(together,一起)+al(grow,成长)+ition(名词后缀)→只有联盟才能一起成长→联盟；索引p404

ex.zh: 选举未产生明显多数后，两党组成了联合政府。

ex.en: Building a broad coalition in favour of reform took nearly two years.
ex.zh: 建立支持改革的广泛联盟花了近两年时间。

senses: v. 哄劝;劝诱;慢慢将……弄好
coax.usage: 辨析: coax 指用好话、善意或耐心劝诱、哄骗某人做某事；索引p404

ex.en: The younger they learn how computers think, how to coax the machine into producing what they want—the earlier they learn that they have the power to do that—the better.
ex.zh: 他们越早了解计算机如何思考，懂得如何让计算机制作完成他们想要的东西，他们就越早了解到自己有能力这么做，对他们也就越好。

ex.en: Every employee is required to follow the company's code of conduct, both in and outside the office.
ex.zh: 每位员工无论在办公室内外都必须遵守公司的行为准则。

ex.en: The message was written in a secret code that enemy intelligence never managed to break.
ex.zh: 这条信息是用敌方情报机构始终未能破译的密码写成的。

ex.en: Learning to code has become as basic a skill as reading and writing in the digital economy.
ex.zh: 在数字经济中，学习编程已成为与读、写一样基础的技能。

senses: n. [U] （两人在感情等方面的）互为依赖

ex.en: The treaty promotes the peaceful coexistence of the two neighbouring states.
ex.zh: 该条约促进两个邻国和平共处。

ex.en: Urban planners seek the coexistence of historic buildings and modern offices.
ex.zh: 城市规划者力求历史建筑与现代办公楼的共存。

ex.en: The coexistence of very different cultures enriched the port city.
ex.zh: 多种极不相同的文化的共存丰富了这座港口城市。

senses: n. [U] 咖啡；[C] 一杯咖啡
adj. 认知的,有关认识的
adj. 认知的；感知的；认识的
cognitive.usage: cogn(知道)+itive(形容词后缀)→认知的;派生cognition n.认知,认识；adj.认识的，认知的；cogn（知道）+it+ive（形容词后缀）→能够知道和认识的→认知的；词根:co(together一起)+gn(know知道)+itive→获得知识→认知的；索引p404

ex.en: It turns out that the brain needs exercise in much the same way our muscles do, and the right mental workouts can significantly improve our basic cognitive functions.
ex.zh: 原来大脑跟肌肉一样需要练习运动,而正确的智力锻炼能极大地提高我们最基本的认知功能。

ex.en: To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms.
ex.zh: 从共有特征中滤出独有特征使我们得以理解复杂的文化行为是如何产生的，并从进化或认知角度理解什么引导了它的走向。

ex.en: Sleep deprivation damages cognitive performance, slowing reaction times and weakening short-term memory.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足损害认知表现，使反应变慢并削弱短期记忆。

senses: n. 一致(性)；连贯(性)；凝聚
adj. 合乎逻辑的；有条理的；清楚易懂的；有表达能力的
adj. 合乎逻辑的；条理清楚的
coherent.usage: 派生coherence一致性,连贯性；adj.连贯的；说话条理清晰的；词根：co(together一起)+her(stick粘贴)+ent形容词后缀→粘贴在一起的→连贯的→合乎逻辑的；索引p404

ex.en: The subjects of the curriculum form a coherent whole.
ex.zh: 课程中的科目构成了一个连贯的整体。

ex.en: A good essay presents a coherent argument, with each paragraph logically connected to the next.
ex.zh: 一篇好文章应提出连贯的论点，各段落在逻辑上层层相承。

ex.en: The witness was still so shocked that she could not give a coherent account of the accident.
ex.zh: 目击者惊魂未定，无法对事故作出条理清晰的叙述。

senses: adj. 粘着的,有结合力的

senses: vi. 同时发生；相同，相符；重叠
coincide.usage: v.巧合，同时发生；一致，相 符；coincide with 与…一致；coincident adj. 同时发生的。；词根记忆: co(together, 一起)+in(on, 在…上面)+cid(fall, 落)+e→同时落到某物上→同时发生；索引p404

ex.en: The interests of employers and employees do not always coincide.
ex.zh: 雇主和雇员的利益并不总是一致的。

ex.en: My views coincide with hers.
ex.zh: 我的观点和她的一致。

ex.en: My views coincide with hers.
ex.zh: 我的观点和她的一致。

ex.en: It was pure coincidence that they were both in Paris on the same day.
ex.zh: 他们俩同一天都在巴黎，纯属巧合。

ex.en: By coincidence, both studies reached similar conclusions using entirely different methods.
ex.zh: 巧合的是，两项研究用完全不同的方法得出了相似的结论。

ex.en: The similarity between the two designs is too close to be mere coincidence.
ex.zh: 这两个设计如此相似，绝非单纯的巧合。

ex.en: Statisticians warn that people tend to see patterns where only coincidence exists.
ex.zh: 统计学家警告说，人们往往在只存在巧合的地方看出规律。

senses: adj. 同时发生的；在同一地方发生的

ex.en: Shakespeare's lifetime was coincident with a period of extraordinary activity and achievement in the drama.
ex.zh: 莎士比亚的一生刚好赶上戏剧发展的一段非凡的活跃期和成就期。

senses: a. 寒冷的；冷却的；冷漠的
vi. (尤指在文艺、科学等方面)合作,协作
collaborate.usage: 助记:col(共同)+labor(劳动)→合作;派生collaboration协作；col(=con，表示"一起")+labor(劳动)+ate(动词后缀)→一起劳动→合作；collaborate with sb on sth 在某事上与某人合作。；索引p404

ex.en: She agreed to collaborate with him in writing her biography.
ex.zh: 她同意与他合作撰写她的传记。

ex.en: The US Federal Trade Commission intends to encourage research collaboration.
ex.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会打算鼓励科研合作。

ex.en: The new vaccine was developed in collaboration between two universities.
ex.zh: 新疫苗是由两所大学合作研制的。

ex.en: Close collaboration between designers and engineers shortened the development cycle.
ex.zh: 设计师与工程师的密切合作缩短了开发周期。

senses: adj. 合作的,协作的,协力完成的

collapse.usage: v./n.倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；col（共同）+laps（滑，滑走）+e→一起滑落→倒塌。；词根记忆: col(together, 共同)+laps(fall, 滑落)+e→一起滑落→崩溃；真 Integrity had collapsed 城信正直已经崩塌(2015)；索引p404

ex.en: Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only "sorting mechanism" in society should be profit and the market.
ex.zh: 她认为，正直已经崩溃，因为人们普遍认为，社会中唯一的“分类机制”应该是利润和市场。

ex.en: The emerging consensus around the bill is a sign that legislators are getting frightened about a politically embarrassing short-term collapse at the USPS.
ex.zh: 围绕这一法案渐趋一致的看法似乎表明，立法者们越来越担心美国邮政署的短期崩溃让他们在政治上感到困窘。

ex.en: The bridge collapsed without warning, prompting an immediate review of similar structures nationwide.
ex.zh: 大桥在毫无预警的情况下坍塌，促使全国立即对类似建筑展开检查。

ex.en: If you're not sure, ask for honest feedback from trusted friends, colleagues, and professionals.
ex.zh: 如果你不确定,那么,就向值得你信任的朋友、同事、专业人士征求真诚的反馈。

ex.en: Her colleagues organised a farewell party before she moved to the head office.
ex.zh: 在她调往总部之前，同事们为她举办了一场欢送会。

ex.en: Managers should treat younger colleagues as partners rather than subordinates.
ex.zh: 管理者应把年轻同事当作伙伴而不是下属。

collect.usage: col（=con，所有的）+lect（选择）→所有的都选择了→收集。；索引p404

ex.en: The decisions made it more difficult for states to collect sales tax on certain online purchases.
ex.zh: 这些裁决使得各州更难对某些在线购物行为征收销售税。

ex.en: Researchers collected data from more than five thousand households over a decade.
ex.zh: 研究人员在十年间收集了五千多个家庭的数据。

ex.en: The library collects rare maps printed before 1800.
ex.zh: 这家图书馆专门收藏1800年以前印制的稀有地图。

ex.en: New sensors collect information on air quality every hour.
ex.zh: 新型传感器每小时收集一次空气质量信息。

senses: n. 收藏（品）；一群人，一堆东西；聚集，积聚；作品集

ex.en: The museum's collection of modern paintings attracts visitors from around the world.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆的现代绘画收藏吸引着世界各地的游客。

ex.en: The library holds a unique collection of manuscripts from the Middle Ages.
ex.zh: 该图书馆收藏了一批独特的中世纪手稿。

ex.en: The collection of taxes has become more efficient since records went digital.
ex.zh: 自记录数字化以来，税收征收变得更有效率。

ex.en: The problem demands collective action rather than isolated national efforts.
ex.zh: 这一问题需要集体行动，而不是各国孤立的单独努力。

ex.en: The strike was a collective decision taken by all of the factory's workers.
ex.zh: 罢工是全厂工人共同作出的决定。

ex.en: Individual choices can gradually reshape the collective behaviour of consumers.
ex.zh: 个人选择能够逐渐重塑消费者的集体行为。

senses: n. [C,U]（美国）大学；高等职业学院

ex.en: Two cargo trains collided near the border, injuring dozens of crew members.
ex.zh: 两列货运列车在边境附近相撞，数十名乘务人员受伤。

ex.en: The proposal collided with the board's long-term expansion strategy.
ex.zh: 该提案与董事会的长期扩张战略发生冲突。

ex.en: Scientists observed what happens when particles collide at nearly the speed of light.
ex.zh: 科学家观察了粒子以接近光速对撞时会发生什么。

ex.en: The collision between the two ships spilled oil across the bay.
ex.zh: 两船相撞使石油泄漏到整个海湾。

ex.en: New data protection rules are on a collision course with the advertising industry.
ex.zh: 新的数据保护规则与广告业势将发生冲突。

ex.zh: 该报告审视了经济增长与环境保护之间的冲突。

生活在印度这块殖民地上的英国人

ex.en: Many colonial buildings in the old town have been converted into museums.
ex.zh: 老城中许多殖民时期的建筑已被改建为博物馆。

ex.en: Colonial trade patterns still shape the economies of several regions today.
ex.zh: 殖民时期的贸易模式至今仍影响着一些地区的经济。

ex.en: Historians continue to debate the economic legacy of colonial rule.
ex.zh: 历史学家仍在争论殖民统治留下的经济遗产。

ex.en: The colony declared independence after more than a century of foreign rule.
ex.zh: 该殖民地经过一百多年的外国统治后宣布独立。

ex.en: An ant colony can organise complex tasks without any central leader.
ex.zh: 蚁群无需中央领导者就能组织复杂的任务。

ex.en: Artists formed a small colony in the fishing village in the 1920s.
ex.zh: 二十世纪二十年代，艺术家们在这个渔村形成了一个小小的聚居地。

combat.usage: com（都）+bat（打）→大家一起打→战斗；索引p404

ex.en: And that is very good news because the Internet may well be the most powerful tool for combating world poverty that we've ever had.
ex.zh: 那是一个非常好的消息，因为互联网很可能是有史以来与世界贫困作斗争的最有力的工具。

ex.en: To combat the trap of putting a premium on being busy, Gal Newport, author of Deep Work: Rules for Focused Success in a Distracted World, recommends building a habit of "deep work"—the ability to focus without distraction.
ex.zh: 人们往往看中流于表面的忙碌，为摆脱这种误区，《深度工作：在容易分心的世界保持专注的法则》一书的作者盖尔·纽波特推荐养成一种"深度工作"的习惯——一种不会分心的专注能力。

ex.en: Police forces have adopted new technologies to combat online fraud.
ex.zh: 警方已采用新技术来打击网络诈骗。

ex.en: The soldiers were exhausted after months of combat in the mountainous region.
ex.zh: 在山区经过数月战斗后，士兵们已精疲力竭。

senses: a. 好战的；好斗的；好争论的

ex.en: Longevity results from a combination of mental and physical health.
ex.zh: 长寿是心理和身体健康相结合的结果。

ex.en: Success in the examination depends on a combination of hard work and sound technique.
ex.zh: 考试的成功取决于刻苦努力与正确方法的结合。

ex.en: The new device is a combination of a telephone and a portable computer.
ex.zh: 这种新装置是电话与便携式电脑的结合体。

ex.en: In combination with regular exercise, the drug significantly reduces blood pressure.
ex.zh: 与规律运动相结合，这种药物能显著降低血压。

combine.usage: v.结合，组合；合并 n.联盟，联合体；com(联想成company"公司")+bine(发音类似"并")→公司合并了就是"联合，结合"；索引p404

ex.en: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines.
ex.zh: 在以往技术迅猛革新的时代，企业家们通过设想出将人力与机器相结合的方式实现了平稳过渡。

ex.en: The new course combines traditional lectures with online discussions, giving students far more flexibility.
ex.zh: 新课程将传统授课与在线讨论结合起来，给了学生更大的灵活性。

ex.en: Hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water, one of the most basic reactions in nature.
ex.zh: 氢和氧化合成水，这是自然界最基本的反应之一。

come.usage: come along进展;come by得到;come off举行,成功;come out出版;come up发生;come up to达标;come up with提出

senses: n. 某事物的有趣方面;幽默
comedy.usage: come(来)+dy(谐音“抖音”)→来抖音看搞笑视频→看喜剧→喜剧

ex.en: The film blends comedy with a serious message about family.
ex.zh: 这部影片将喜剧与关于家庭的严肃主题融为一体。

ex.en: Shakespeare's comedies often end with marriage and reconciliation.
ex.zh: 莎士比亚的喜剧常以婚姻与和解收场。

ex.en: Standing on stage, she discovered a real gift for comedy.
ex.zh: 站在舞台上，她发现了自己真正的喜剧天赋。

ex.en: The hotel offers every comfort its business guests could ask for.
ex.zh: 这家酒店提供商务客人可能需要的一切舒适设施。

ex.en: Friends tried to comfort her after the sudden loss of her job.
ex.zh: 朋友们在她突然失业后尽力安慰她。

ex.en: Many graduates choose stable jobs for the comfort of a regular income.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生为了固定收入带来的安稳而选择稳定的工作。

comic.usage: 记：com（宴会）+-ic（形容词后缀）→宴会上小丑的表演使人发笑→滑稽的；派生comical滑稽的;comic opera喜剧歌剧

ex.en: The writer is known for her comic timing and sharp dialogue.
ex.zh: 这位作家以精准的喜剧节奏和犀利的对白著称。

ex.en: Children still love comic books even in the age of streaming.
ex.zh: 即使在流媒体时代，孩子们仍然喜爱连环画。

ex.en: His comic account of the journey kept the whole train laughing.
ex.zh: 他对旅途的滑稽描述逗笑了整节车厢的人。

command.usage: v./n.命令；指挥；控制，掌管；索引p404

ex.en: The general assumed command of the allied forces shortly before the offensive.
ex.zh: 将军在进攻前不久接管了盟军部队的指挥权。

ex.en: She has an excellent command of English, which helped her secure the scholarship.
ex.zh: 她英语掌握得非常好，这帮助她获得了奖学金。

ex.en: The officer commanded the troops to withdraw to safer ground.
ex.zh: 军官命令部队撤到更安全的地方。

senses: vt. 纪念，作为对……的纪念
commemorate.usage: 助记:com(共同)+memor(记忆)+ate(动词后缀)→共同做记忆→纪念；v.纪念，用以纪念；索引p404

ex.en: A statue was erected in the square to commemorate the city's founders.
ex.zh: 广场上竖起一座雕像以纪念这座城市的创建者。

ex.en: The annual ceremony commemorates those who died in the war.
ex.zh: 一年一度的仪式纪念在战争中逝去的人们。

ex.en: The museum will hold a special exhibition to commemorate the centenary of the event.
ex.zh: 博物馆将举办特别展览以纪念该事件一百周年。

commence.usage: 派生commencement开始;助记:commence(开始)与commerce(商业) n换r

comment.usage: remark 的近义词；n.评论，意见；批评，指 责 v.评论，发表意见；com（共同）+men（人）+t（他）→所有人都对他评头论足→评论；索引p404

ex.en: You have to register to post a comment.
ex.zh: 你必须注册才能发表评论。

ex.en: The minister refused to comment on the leaked report until its contents had been officially confirmed.
ex.zh: 在报告内容得到官方证实之前，部长拒绝就泄露的报告发表评论。

ex.en: The teacher wrote encouraging comments at the end of each student's essay.
ex.zh: 老师在每位学生的文章末尾写下了鼓励性的评语。

commerce.usage: [族] commercial a. 商业的；派生commercial n.（电台或电视播放的）广告 adj.商业的；词根记忆：com(together,一起)+merce(merchandise,从商)→一起从商→商业；索引p404

ex.en: Another major shift in the model for Internet commerce concerns the technology available for marketing.
ex.zh: 互联网商务模式的另一个重大转变涉及可用于营销的技术。

ex.en: In the nineteenth century the river was the main artery of commerce for the region.
ex.zh: 十九世纪，这条河是该地区商业的主要动脉。

ex.en: The chamber of commerce estimates that the new port will double regional trade.
ex.zh: 商会估计新港口将使区域贸易翻一番。

ex.en: Universities are increasingly expected to serve the needs of industry and commerce.
ex.zh: 人们越来越期望大学满足工商业的需求。

commercial.usage: adj.商业的，商务的；商业化 的 n.电视广告，电台广告；索引p404

ex.en: He did a number of commercials for major brands.
ex.zh: 他为主要品牌做了许多广告。

ex.en: The success of the project was commercial rather than artistic, but it kept the studio alive.
ex.zh: 这个项目的成功是商业上的而非艺术上的，但它让工作室得以维持下去。

ex.en: Television commercials aimed at young children have been banned in several European countries.
ex.zh: 几个欧洲国家已禁止针对幼儿的电视广告。

commission.usage: com-(共同)+miss(送)→把任务送出去→委托→受委托的一群人→委员会；n.委员会；佣金；委托 v.委任，任命……为军官；词根记忆: com(together, 一起)+miss(send, 送)+ion(名词后缀)→委托他人寄送→委托；索引p404

ex.en: America's Federal Trade commission launched a round of talks about how to save newspapers.
ex.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会就如何拯救报业展开了一轮探讨。

ex.en: The commission argued that other agencies would protect against anti-competitive behavior.
ex.zh: (联邦通信)委员会认为，其他机构将会保护人们免受反竞争行为的侵害。

ex.en: She earns a commission of ten percent on every house she sells for the agency.
ex.zh: 她为该机构每售出一套房子可获得百分之十的佣金。

senses: n. [C] 部长；警察局局长；委员
n. (委员会的)委员；警长；(政府部门的)官员

ex.en: The police commissioner promised an independent review of the case.
ex.zh: 警察局长承诺对该案进行独立审查。

ex.en: European commissioners meet monthly to discuss trade and competition policy.
ex.zh: 欧盟委员每月开会讨论贸易与竞争政策。

ex.en: The election commissioner announced stricter rules for campaign advertising.
ex.zh: 选举事务专员宣布了更严格的竞选广告规则。

commit.usage: com-(加强)+mit(送)→把自己交出去→承诺→干出（坏事）；[族] commitment n. 承诺；奉献；拓展：commit suicide 自杀；commit oneself to 致力于；词根记忆: com(together, 一起)+mit(send, 送)→承诺一起寄送→承诺；索引p404

ex.en: They want to see the text of the proposed treaty before fully committing themselves.
ex.zh: 他们想先看看拟议条约的文本，然后再作出充分承诺。

ex.en: We need them to imagine the United States as a place where they can be productive for a while without committing themselves to staying forever.
ex.zh: 我们需要他们把美国想象成这样一个地方：他们可以在一段时间内取得成果，而不需要承诺永久留下。

ex.en: The court found that he had committed a serious error of judgment in approving the loan.
ex.zh: 法庭认定，他在批准这笔贷款时犯了严重的判断错误。

commitment.usage: n.献身；承诺；奉献，投入； 义务；n.献身；承诺；投入；义务；commit 的派生词；索引p404

ex.en: I know we seem to be moving toward a first-quarter commitment here.
ex.zh: 我知道我们似乎正朝着第一季度的承诺(目标)迈进。

ex.en: Balancing a demanding career and family life requires time, energy and firm commitment.
ex.zh: 兼顾要求苛刻的职业和家庭生活需要时间、精力和坚定的投入。

ex.en: The government has made a firm commitment to halving carbon emissions within fifteen years.
ex.zh: 政府已作出坚定承诺，将在十五年内把碳排放量减半。
